fresh_holders_meta.definition: address first normal on-chain transaction across tracked EVM activity sources within the selected period, plus required conservative DeBank wallet age fallback/cross-check for fresh candidates, with current liquid DOLO plus veDOLO locked exposure above 10K DOLO
fresh_holders_meta.walletActivitySource: Etherscan v2 txlist + Routescan Berachain txlist + DeBank rendered wallet age fallback
fresh_holders_meta.walletAgeBoundaryPolicy: DeBank rendered age labels are treated as ranges; a fallback wallet is included only when the upper bound fits inside the selected period.
